title: Add /api/license endpoint to expose license status
description: Purl serverda /api/license endpoint qo'shish - hozirgi license holati haqida ma'lumot qaytaradi: plan, features, limits, expiry, activation holati. Dashboard'dan foydalanuvchi ko'rishi uchun. Bu endpoint auth bilan himoyalangan bo'lishi kerak.
design: GET /api/license - protected route. License middleware'dan get_license_info() chaqirib, JSON qaytaradi: { plan, features, limits: { servers, retention_days, users, alerts }, expires_at, activated, instance_id }. Agar license bo'lmasa: { plan: 'free', features: ['log_search', 'live_tail', 'basic_alerts'], limits: { servers: 3, retention_days: 7 } }
close_reason: Added GET /api/license endpoint to Server.pm returning plan, features, limits, activation status

title: Update install.sh to prompt for PURL_LICENSE_KEY
description: install.sh skriptiga license key so'rash qo'shish. O'rnatish jarayonida foydalanuvchidan PURL_LICENSE_KEY so'raladi (ixtiyoriy - Enter bilan o'tkazib yuborsa free plan). Kiritilgan key .env yoki docker-compose.yml'ga yoziladi. Kubernetes variantida secret yaratish uchun ko'rsatma beradi.
design: install.sh'da purl server o'rnatish qismiga qo'shish: read -p "Enter your Purl license key (press Enter for Free plan): " LICENSE_KEY. Agar berilsa - PURL_LICENSE_KEY=$LICENSE_KEY env'ga yozish. Docker: docker-compose.yml environment section'ga. Systemd: /etc/purl/purl.env'ga. K8s: kubectl create secret ko'rsatmasi.
close_reason: Added license key prompt to both Docker and Systemd install functions in install.sh

title: Create Purl::API::Middleware::License module
description: License tekshirish uchun yangi middleware yaratish. Bu modul JWT license key ni offline verify qiladi (RSA public key bilan), expiry tekshiradi, plan/features/limits ma'lumotlarini parse qiladi, va natijani cache'laydi. Agar license key berilmagan bo'lsa - free plan sifatida ishlaydi (graceful degradation). Auth.pm patterniga amal qilish kerak.
design: lib/Purl/API/Middleware/License.pm yaratish. Moo class, has config/cache/license_info attributes. Methods: verify_license() - JWT verify + expiry check + plan extract. get_license_info() - cached license data qaytaradi. is_feature_allowed($feature) - plan bo'yicha feature tekshiradi. check_limits() - server/retention limits. _verify_jwt_offline($token) - Crypt::JWT bilan RS256 verify. activate_with_api() - startup'da purlogs.com/api/license/activate'ga so'rov yuboradi. Graceful: agar PURL_LICENSE_KEY bo'sh bo'lsa - free plan, cheklovlar bilan ishlaydi.
close_reason: Created Purl::API::Middleware::License with offline JWT verification, API activation, heartbeat, feature gating, and graceful degradation to free plan

title: Add Crypt::JWT and related dependencies to cpanfile
description: License key JWT RS256 formatda. Perl backend'da JWT token ni verify qilish uchun Crypt::JWT moduli kerak. cpanfile'ga dependency qo'shish. Shuningdek Sys::Hostname instanceId uchun kerak.
design: cpanfile'ga qo'shish: requires 'Crypt::JWT', '0.035'; - JWT RS256 verify uchun. Crypt::JWT CryptX paketiga bog'liq - RSA public key bilan signature tekshiradi.

title: Add license config defaults and ENV mappings to Config.pm
description: Purl::Config moduliga license konfiguratsiya qo'shish kerak. $DEFAULTS hash'ga license section qo'shiladi: license_key, public_key, api_url (purlogs.com), cache_ttl. ENV mapping'lar: PURL_LICENSE_KEY, PURL_LICENSE_PUBLIC_KEY, PURL_LICENSE_API_URL. Bu barcha keyingi license tasklarga asos bo'ladi.
design: Config.pm $DEFAULTS hash'ga qo'shish: license => { key => '', public_key => '', api_url => 'https://purlogs.com', verify_on_startup => 1, cache_ttl => 3600 }. ENV priority: PURL_LICENSE_KEY > config file > default. get() method allaqachon ENV > File > Default tartibida ishlaydi.
close_reason: Added license config defaults and ENV mappings to Config.pm

title: Integrate license middleware into Server.pm route chain
description: Server.pm'dagi setup_routes() metodiga license middleware'ni integratsiya qilish. Auth middleware'dan keyin, protected routes middleware'ga license check qo'shish. Startup'da license activation API'ga so'rov yuborish. License info'ni stash'ga qo'yish - controllerlar foydalanishi uchun. health/metrics endpointlar exempt qilinishi kerak.
design: setup_routes() line 144-147 dan keyin License middleware instantiate. $protected under block'ga license check qo'shish (auth check'dan keyin). Startup'da activate_with_api() chaqirish - natijani log qilish. $c->stash('license_info') orqali controllerlarga license ma'lumot uzatish. /api/health, /api/metrics - license check'dan exempt.
close_reason: Integrated license middleware into Server.pm: startup activation, protected route stash, 6-hour heartbeat timer
